note: Multi-session series — the long runs that don't fit the one-off engagement list. Each episode is one announcement poster: drop the poster in assets/img/engagements/<poster_dir>/, add an entry to episodes, then run `python3 tools/optimise-series.py`. Titles are transcribed exactly as they appear on the poster; "en" is an English gloss shown in the viewer and only where the printed title is not already English. A missing row means a missing poster, not a missing session — the copy on the site says so, so never let a count read as a total number of sessions run.

series.name: Talk With CEO
series.role: Host, and speaker for most episodes
series.lede: From July 2020 to January 2024, Talk With CEO ran in two phases: a weekly live session on Zoom through August 2021, then occasional sessions at Maxxima Lifestyle Hub. Each session had an announcement poster. These are the posters that survived.
series.summary: A live session for entrepreneurs, small business owners and sales agents. It began as a weekly Zoom run, then continued as occasional in-person sessions. Sales, follow-up, mindset, marketing and the basics of running something small.
why: Most people meet me through my AI talks. This series is where I learned to teach, a few years before that.

For over a year I explained how to make the second phone call, how to follow up without sounding desperate, and how to keep going when sales are slow. The audience was small business owners and agents. They asked direct questions and expected answers they could use the next morning.
series.format: Live on Zoom through 2021, then occasional sessions at Maxxima Lifestyle Hub.
series.audience: Entrepreneurs, small-business owners, agents and distributors
